enableApps.title: Apps
enableApps.description: Show the Apps navigation and allow access to app connections, gateways, and advanced app tooling.

autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.title: Auto-Restart Dev Server When Idle
autoRestartDevServerWhenIdle.description: In `pnpm dev:once`, wait for all queued and running local agent runs to finish, then restart the server automatically when backend changes or migrations make the current boot stale.

enableBetaSkills.title: Beta skills
enableBetaSkills.description: Allow agents to pin beta releases of the Paperclip core skill. Disabling this returns every agent to the default live skill without removing saved pins.

enableBuiltInAgents.title: Built-in Agents
enableBuiltInAgents.description: Show Paperclip-managed built-in agent surfaces, including built-in roster badges, the Built-in agents tab, and built-in agent setup controls.

enableCases.title: Cases
enableCases.description: Durable work products (blog posts, tweet storms…) that tasks create and iterate on. Adds the Cases tab and the agent case API.
enableCases.footnote: Turning Cases off hides the tab and blocks the case API; existing case data is kept.

enableClassicTaskInterface.title: Classic Task Interface
enableClassicTaskInterface.description: Restores the previous task detail page: the page-level header with inline description editing, the plain comment thread, and the fixed Properties sidebar. Chat-only features — streaming activity folding, inline plan and question cards, the three-mode composer — are unavailable in the classic view.
enableClassicTaskInterface.footnote: Switching takes effect immediately. No task data is affected.

enableConferenceRoomChat.title: Conference Room Chat
enableConferenceRoomChat.description: Adds a Conference Room — one chat where you and your whole team work together — plus the live activity feed and the redesigned onboarding. Also restyles task threads as chat bubbles. Turn off anytime to restore the classic UI.

enableDecisions.title: Decisions
enableDecisions.description: Show the Decisions item in the main sidebar — the attention home that surfaces the tasks awaiting your input — while the surface is still being evaluated.

enableEnvironments.title: Enable Environments
enableEnvironments.description: Show environment management in company settings and allow project and agent environment assignment controls.

enableExternalObjects.title: Enable External Objects
enableExternalObjects.description: Detect external URLs in issues and show resolved status for pull requests, tickets, and other referenced work objects.

enableIsolatedWorkspaces.title: Enable Isolated Workspaces
enableIsolatedWorkspaces.description: Show execution workspace controls in project configuration and allow isolated workspace behavior for new and existing task runs.

enableExperimentalFileViewer.title: Experimental File Viewer
enableExperimentalFileViewer.description: Show task detail controls for browsing and previewing workspace files relative to a task.

enableGoalsSidebarLink.title: Goals Sidebar Link
enableGoalsSidebarLink.description: Restore the Goals item in the main sidebar while the goals surface is being evaluated.

enableManagedSandboxOnly.title: Managed Environment Only
enableManagedSandboxOnly.description: Hide the local environment and run all agents in the platform-managed environment.

enableServerInfoDebugView.title: Server Info Debug View
enableServerInfoDebugView.description: Show a "Server" section in the account drawer with the current server restart time and running commit.

enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.title: Simplified English Interactions
enableSimplifiedEnglishInteractions.description: Instruct agents to write user interactions (plan confirmations, questions, suggested tasks, checkbox prompts) in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, with brief context on what information the decision needs and what happens for each choice.

enableSmokeLab.title: Smoke Lab
enableSmokeLab.description: Add a "Smoke Lab" tab under Apps → Developer and an "Integration smoke" card on the dashboard for exercising every integration path against deterministic local fixtures (fake OAuth provider + loopback MCP servers). Private (non-public) deployments only.

enableStatusCards.title: Status Cards
enableStatusCards.description: Enable the experimental shared status-card board and its gated API. Existing card data is kept when this is disabled.
enableStatusCards.footnote: Enabling Status Cards also enables Summaries.

enableSummaries.title: Summaries
enableSummaries.description: Show Summarizer-generated status slots on project and workspace pages, with on-demand refresh and revision history. Existing summary data is kept when this is disabled.
enableSummaries.footnote: Status Cards requires Summaries. Disabling Summaries also disables Status Cards.

enableIssuePlanDecompositions.title: Task Plan Decomposition Panel
enableIssuePlanDecompositions.description: Show accepted-plan decomposition history on task detail pages. Intended for debugging and validating subtask creation behavior while the presentation is still being refined.

enableTaskWatchdogs.title: Task Watchdogs
enableTaskWatchdogs.description: Show task detail controls for configuring watchdog agents that verify stopped task subtrees and restore live paths when work should continue.
